column1: # The 73 books of the Bible, in the Vulgate's order, with the codes source pointers use. The names and the testaments
# (ot, nt, and ap for the deuterocanonical books) are those of the Biblia Sacra Vulgata as BibleGateway gives it
# (version VULGATE), from which the project's table of verses was made.
# The older Vulgate names four books otherwise: I and II Samuelis are I and II Regum there, and I and II Regum
